initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is 24/60 − 27/90 = 0.10. R214-1 supplies consistency and no interference but no assumption identifying the missing counterfactual outcomes. Thus the requested average causal risk difference is not uniquely identified; passing arithmetic checks does not establish identification.
